full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media portrait shows a young adult man's face and upper neck filling nearly the entire frame against a pale worked-paper background. His dark wavy hair presses into the top and side edges, with loose curls framing both ears. He faces directly forward and looks toward the viewer with clear blue-gray eyes beneath thick brows. A long straight nose, slightly parted full lips, and short moustache and beard are rendered through layered ocher, gray, and deep blue marks. Pale creamy strokes cut across the forehead and cheekbones, while darker hatching gathers beneath the eyes, around the jaw, and under the chin. His expression is still and searching, with no exaggerated smile or gesture. The neck and suggestion of clothing dissolve into sketchier marks along the lower edge. Around the head, the off-white ground carries faint vertical rulings, thin horizontal cross-lines, and translucent patches that remain visibly unfinished. Wide dry-brush strokes, fine pencil construction lines, and small scratched highlights cross one another on the face. The color range is restrained: cool navy and slate blue anchor the hair and shadows, and warm beige or rose-brown give the skin depth. Light seems to come from the front and slightly above, brightening the forehead, nose bridge, and upper cheeks, while the lower face settles into blue-gray shade. The eyes and central features are sharper than the hair edges and background. No readable text appears. The overall composition is close and frontal, allowing precise human observation to coexist with visible revisions, layered textures, and the energy of an unfinished study.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介肖像呈现一名年轻成年男子的脸和上段颈部，几乎填满画面，背后是经过反复处理的浅色纸底。深色波浪发挤到上方和两侧边缘，松散卷发围着双耳。他正面朝向观者，厚眉下清澈的蓝灰色眼睛看向前方。挺直的长鼻、微张的丰满嘴唇和短小的胡须由层叠赭色、灰色与深蓝色痕迹塑造。浅奶油色笔触横过额头与颧骨，较深排线则聚在眼下、下颌周围和下巴底部。他的表情静止而带探询感，没有夸张笑容或动作。颈部和隐约可见的衣服在下缘逐渐散入更草率的笔痕。头部周围，灰白底色保留淡淡竖线、细水平交叉线和半透明色块，看起来刻意未完工。宽阔的干笔、细铅笔构图线和小片刮出的亮痕在脸上互相穿过。色域十分克制：冷海军蓝与石板蓝稳住头发和阴影，暖米色或玫瑰棕色为皮肤增添纵深。光似乎来自正面稍偏上方，照亮额头、鼻梁与上颊，脸下部则沉入蓝灰色阴影。眼睛和中央五官比发际及背景更清晰。画面没有可读文字。整体构图紧凑而正面，让准确的人物观察与可见的修改痕迹、层叠肌理和未完成习作的活力并存。
style_prompt_en: The mixed-media treatment layers broad dry paint, fine pencil scaffolding, and scratched highlights over an off-white ground. Cool navy and slate-blue masses establish deep values, while translucent beige, muted rose, and creamy light marks build warmer planes. Some edges are tightly observed and sharply drawn; others break into loose strokes and open construction lines, so finish varies deliberately across the frame. Crosshatching and short directional marks model recesses without smoothing away the hand of the artist. Faint rulings and pale patches remain visible beneath the main forms, adding depth to the surface itself. Light is broad and frontal, concentrating brightness near the center and letting lower and peripheral areas cool and darken. The overall effect is immediate and layered, balancing convincing volume with a lively record of the drawing process.
style_prompt_zh: 这种混合媒介表现把宽阔干笔、细铅笔辅助线和刮出的亮痕叠在灰白底面上。冷海军蓝与石板蓝色块建立深明度，半透明米色、低饱和玫瑰色和奶油色亮笔再构成较暖的平面。有些边缘被准确观察并清晰描出，另一些碎成松散笔触和开放的构图线，因此全画面的完成度有意变化。交叉排线与短促的定向痕迹塑造凹处，却不抹去作者手感。淡辅助线和浅色块仍透在主要形态下方，为表面本身增加深度。光线宽阔而偏正面，亮度集中在中央，较低与外围区域逐渐转冷、转暗。整体效果直接而层叠，让可信体积与鲜活的绘画过程痕迹达到平衡。
theme_en: A blue-eyed man in a layered painterly and pencil portrait
theme_zh: 以层叠绘画和铅笔线描呈现的蓝眼男子肖像
name: David Rees
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
